meta.name: story-short-scan
meta.description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫遍热门平台，掌握短篇网文爆款题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是短篇网文作者，想快速知道最近什么题材受欢迎
copy.tagline_en: Scan top platforms to spot viral short-story topics.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write short fiction and need to know what's trending.

howto.what: Claude 会当短篇网文市场分析师:确认平台和方向后,用 browser-cdp 抓榜或用户提供的数据做依据,产出含情绪热度排行、题材热点、风口预警和可写方向的扫榜报告,并给出选题匹配。
howto.when: 当你提到「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」等说法,或输入 /story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜 时触发。

say.text: 扫一下知乎盐言的短篇榜,找风口题材
say.note: 会先问平台和类型方向

say.text: 对比一下七猫和点众短篇的题材热度
我想写虐恋,看看现在还火不火
say.note: 按你的方向做定向扫榜

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a short-fiction market analyst: after confirming platform and direction, it gathers data via browser-cdp or user-provided sources, then outputs a scan report covering emotion rankings, hot genres, trend alerts and writable directions, plus topic matching.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say things like "what's hot in short fiction" or "Zhihu story rankings", or run /story-short-scan or /短篇扫榜.

say_en.text: Scan Zhihu Yanyan's short story rankings and find trending genres
say_en.note: It asks platform and direction first
